summary: Blocked before editing: the existing transport core and companion authority do not yet provide a secure pairing-secret lifecycle that can be integrated without inventing authentication semantics. The core creates a fresh per-connection Session, while companion.rs persists only metadata and exposes no secret lookup or ephemeral pairing-key handoff. Its TransportHandle also cannot close detached per-connection threads. Integrating the requested Tauri/SQLite/Android flow now would either bypass the existing authority or claim authenticated pairing without a securely shared key, so no files were modified or committed.

Get-Content lib.rs AppState, test_state, and command registration

tests.details: Blocked before implementation because the required secure pairing-secret lifecycle and connection shutdown API are absent.

remaining_issues: Define a secure ephemeral pairing-key handoff between explicit Owner-confirmed start, Android SecureStore, and the transport Session without persisting raw secrets.
Extend TransportHandle with synchronized connection tracking and deterministic shutdown of all active connections.
Then add the manager, Tauri commands, SQLite callback integration, Android socket integration, UI, and requested validation gates.
